page.overview:
Who is Aaron Davis?

Aaron Davis seemingly had the same history as the rewritten history of his Earth-1610 counterpart. He became estranged from his family when he became the super villain Prowler. He created the Wilder Pack to combat the Wild Pack after they recruited Symbiote Spider-Man. They eventually amassed an army and defeated the majority of New York City's super heroes, but were be defeated by their prisoners from the Mutant Pits.

Later, his nephew, Spider-Man, convinced him to turn over a new leaf and become a true super hero. He was recruited by S.H.I.E.L.D. into the Spider-Men, a group of Spider-Man analogs assembled to combat the Multiversal Sinister Six. Unfortunately, Prowler was blackmailed by Green Goblin into going back to crime by kidnapping his brother. Miles found out and after Aaron explained his situation, the two teamed-up and rescued Jefferson.
